mapper.select: SELECT * FROM HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY WHERE ID=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY SET OPERATION_ID=#{operationId},OPERATION_STATUS='RUNNING' WHERE ID=1 AND OPERATION_ID IS NULL AND OPERATION_STATUS='IDLE'
UPDATE HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY SET OPERATION_ID=NULL,OPERATION_STATUS='IDLE',EXPECTED_SAMPLES=NULL WHERE ID=1 AND OPERATION_ID=#{operationId} AND OPERATION_STATUS='RUNNING'

UPDATE HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY SET MODEL_NAME=#{control.modelName}, MODEL_VERSION=#{control.modelVersion}, VECTOR_DIM=#{control.vectorDim}, REVISION=REVISION+1 WHERE ID=1 AND OPERATION_ID=#{control.operationId} AND REVISION=#{control.revision} AND OPERATION_STATUS='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TPIF_HTDLYB WHERE MODEL_VERSION=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY SET OPERATION_STATUS='DB_COMMITTED',EXPECTED_SAMPLES=#{expectedSamples} WHERE ID=1 AND OPERATION_ID=#{operationId} AND OPERATION_STATUS='RUNNING'
UPDATE HT_SAMPLE_LIBRARY SET OPERATION_ID=NULL,OPERATION_STATUS='IDLE',EXPECTED_SAMPLES=NULL WHERE ID=1 AND OPERATION_ID=#{operationId} AND OPERATION_STATUS='DB_COMMITTED'
